title: Pricing Defects in Evaluation Environments by Expected Loss: A Probe Battery Evaluated Against Trivial and Prevalence-Aware Floors
description: Reinforcement-learning environments and evaluation suites are routinely deployed on the strength of verifiers that are rarely checked mechanically. Assay is a deterministic-by-default battery of eleven probe families covering 16 defect classes that executes an environment and prices missed defects and false alarms on a single expected-loss scale under a stated cost profile. On 33 environments carrying 54 planted defects under the research-run profile, Assay achieves an expected loss of 57.0 (95% CI 8-142), saving 285.0 (198-339, separated) against the restricted constant floor that flags only the 12 occurring defect classes (342.0) and 417.0 (330-471, separated) against the unrestricted flag_everything floor (474.0, CI 453-492), separating against flag_everything on all four cost profiles. Post hoc against an in-sample Bayes-optimal prevalence-aware constant floor (327.0), Assay saves 270.0 (176-336, separated on three of four cost profiles, not separated on production-training). Precision is 0.757 (17 false alarms, 14 on five environments with no correct answer) and recall is 0.982 (0 true misses, 1 unchecked defect priced as a miss). Because 25 of 33 environments are author-constructed, the 8 third-party environments form the external control: there the saving over flag_everything is 76.0 (95% CI -4 to 121, not separated), and against 62 defects an independent team confirmed in tau2-bench, full-battery recall is 0.339 (p=0.486, indistinguishable from random flagging). An opt-in language-model gate meant to withhold false alarms on no-answer environments deleted two real defects in 1 of 7 identical runs, reducing its mean saving over the deterministic battery to 2.4 (median 14.0). The code is Apache-2.0; deterministic arms reproduce without a GPU or API key. Not peer reviewed. Code, registrations and artifacts: https://github.com/caiotheodoro/assay
notes: Work begun 28 August 2026 (first repository commit e2ca9d4); first paper version (paper-v1.0, Zenodo record 24454920) compiled and deposited 23 November 2026. This version, paper-v2.0, is of 23 November 2026.
